protocol:
1. Put on gloves and set up the bench with an Invitrogen E-Gel EX agarose gel cassette, an Invitrogen E-Gel Power Snap electrophoresis/imaging device, a single-channel micropipette, pipette tips, sample tubes on ice, and a tube rack.

2. Pick up a chilled sample tube from the ice bucket and open the cap.

3. Insert the micropipette tip into the open sample tube and pipette the liquid in the tube.

4. Close or set down the handled sample tube and return it to the ice bucket.

5. Pick up additional chilled sample tubes from the ice bucket or tube rack and open each cap.

6. Pipette liquid from the open sample tubes using the single-channel micropipette.

7. Place the handled tubes back on ice or in the tube rack after pipetting.

8. Position the Invitrogen E-Gel EX agarose gel cassette on the bench with the loading wells accessible.

9. Hold an open sample tube in one hand and guide the micropipette tip to a loading well in the E-Gel cassette.

10. Dispense the sample into a well of the E-Gel EX agarose gel cassette.

11. Withdraw the pipette tip from the gel well and move the pipette away from the gel cassette.

12. Repeat sample handling with another open tube and micropipette tip, then dispense liquid into another well of the E-Gel cassette.

13. Set the micropipette down on the bench and close or secure the sample tube in the tube rack.

14. Lift the loaded E-Gel EX agarose gel cassette and place it into the open Invitrogen E-Gel Power Snap device.

15. Seat the gel cassette flat in the device and align it with the electrophoresis platform.

16. Close the amber lid of the E-Gel Power Snap device over the loaded gel cassette.

17. Use the touchscreen on the E-Gel Power Snap device to select the gel run program.

18. Start the electrophoresis run on the E-Gel Power Snap device; the touchscreen displays a 10:00 minute run timer.

19. Leave the loaded E-Gel cassette running in the closed E-Gel Power Snap device as the countdown timer begins.
